event_text: Reykjavík City detects a cyberattack on several of its computer systems and takes many digital services offline
The Blue Lagoon also reports a cyberattack to CERT-IS; no link to the Reykjavík attack has been shown
The city says its digital services remain offline after a serious cyberattack and that it is working with Syndis and CERT-IS
The city says it aims to bring most systems back that day and over the weekend, and is resetting all passwords and access keys
CERT-IS and civil protection keep Iceland's cyber alert level at the uncertainty level through the weekend
